{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''North Elko Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enr.com/articles/12527-best-project-energyindustrial-pipeline-brings-natural-gas-availability-to-nevada|title=enr.com|website=enr.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Ruby Pipeline main line valve near Willow Creek Reservoir, Nevada to Barrick Goldstrike Mine, near Midas, Nevada.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enr.com/articles/12527-best-project-energyindustrial-pipeline-brings-natural-gas-availability-to-nevada|title=enr.com|website=enr.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
